title: Pest control innovation | Rentokil US Blog
summary: The latest new and exciting innovations from the Rentokil. Discover the science behind our innovative pest control solutions.
body_markdown: At Rentokil, we are proud of our commitment to innovation, research, and science, which has spanned over 95 years. Our cutting-edge technological solutions are constantly advancing with the help of our Global Research and Development Center. Our innovative solutions, such as thermal imaging surveys, intelligent bait stations, electronic and remote monitoring, and AI-driven sensing technology, use the latest technology to produce the most effective solutions. With these cutting-edge innovations, we can detect even the most complex pest infestations, provide 24/7 remote monitoring of premises for pest activity, and offer many other benefits.
